_about: Rules for flh_score (score view + clash detector). Override any key with <fl-headless state folder>/score/rules.json. Pitches use C4 = 60.

low_interval_limits._about: classic arranging 'low interval limits': the LOWER note of each interval (semitones) should not be below this, or the interval turns to mud

chords._about: chord vocabulary for chord naming: suffix -> intervals above the root (fl_music's set plus jazz extensions). 'name|tag' adds another voicing of the same chord name

tolerance._about: how much dissonance a style accepts. ext = extra pitch classes (above the chord root) that count as chord tones; explained = weight kept for a rub between two chord tones (maj7, dominant tritone, 9ths); nct_beats = shortest strong-beat melody note that is checked against the chord; scale multiplies every score; bass_passing_beats = longest bass note that may move by step (1-2 semitones) into a chord tone without being flagged (chromatic approach, walking passing tone); dominant_ext / major_ext = extra tensions on dominant / major chords (the 13th of a dominant is a standard colour outside strict styles)

genre_tolerance._about: words in the journal genre/style (or the profile style / FL project genre) -> tolerance, checked in the order jazz, strict, groove; anything else is normal. groove = normal harmony + idiomatic bass motion (root-fifth, octaves, chromatic approach notes, walking passing tones)

severity._about: issue score -> severity (score ~ beats of a full-velocity mid-register minor 2nd)

abrupt._about: symbolic entrances: a layer coming back after >= silence_bars whose first notes are >= vel_jump louder (MIDI velocity) than its next bars, with no ramp

abrupt_audio._about: fl_review audio: loudness jump over 0.3 s vs the 0.5 s before (LU), held for 1 s, away from section starts
